subject.title: feat(ui): rename, delete, and toggle sidebar session groups

question: Should maintainers continue with this Control UI-only sidebar group-management direction after the pagination and rebase blockers are fixed?
rationale: The PR adds visible group-management UI plus a new persisted browser preference and carries a protected maintainer label, so feature acceptance remains a maintainer choice even though the current correctness blocker is concrete.

options.title: Repair current UI path
options.body: Rebase this branch, fix full pagination for active and archived members, and review the existing Control UI-only implementation as the candidate for the linked issue.

options.title: Choose a gateway bulk API
options.body: Pause this branch and define a bulk group rename/delete RPC if maintainers do not want the UI to enumerate and patch every member session.

options.title: Decline sidebar group management
options.body: Close the linked issue and this PR only if maintainers decide sidebar custom groups should remain lightweight and write-once.

recommendation.title: Repair current UI path
recommendation.body: Rebase this branch, fix full pagination for active and archived members, and review the existing Control UI-only implementation as the candidate for the linked issue.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the linked issue/PR pair and the recent sidebar session-grouping feature history.
